item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Roman Imperial Legislation between Augustus and Nerva (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-15 Diritto romano e fondamenti del diritto europeo

The research aims to study Roman imperial legislation during the early Principate, and in particular the body of constitutions issued during the period spanning the reigns of Augustus and Nerva (27 BC–98 AD). These texts are of fundamental importance not only to historians of Roman law, but also to philologists, archaeologists and historians of classical culture

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Post-doc assignment (Univ. GENOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. GENOVA, Genova
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-04 Diritto del lavoro

The post-doctoral researcher will be required to conduct research in the field of Labour Law, with a particular focus on employment relationships within the context of business fragmentation. The research should begin with a review of the current state of the art before identifying avenues for further scholarly inquiry. In exploring the most promising frontiers, due consideration must be given to transformations in inter-firm relationships—particularly those creating power imbalances—driven by technological innovations, the adoption of new organizational and management models, and the spread of associated new contractual arrangements.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Origins, structure and functions of the curiae in ancient Rome (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-29 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-15 Diritto romano e fondamenti del diritto europeo

item.title: RTT: Ref. 5301 - Digital Innovation and Public Regulation of the Insurance Market (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Forlì
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-03 Diritto dell'economia e dei mercati finanziari e agroalimentari

The project aims to analyze the new relationships between legal regime and economic dynamics within the insurance market resulting from digital innovations and information technologies, which are shaping new models of public regulation in this market. In this context, the project intends to examine the definition of these new models of public regulation, with particular attention to the evolution of European and national legal regulation of the insurance market, as well as to the new digital methods of supervising the economic actors operating within the market itself.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: From formal equality to gender anti-subordination: legal sources, courts and public policies in the Italian legal system and from a comparative perspective (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-11 Diritto comparato

The research aims to analyse the evolution of the principle of equality, from its formal and substantive dimensions to the progressive emergence of the principle of gender anti-subordination in contemporary constitutional law. Through an examination of legal sources, case law and public policies, the study seeks to explore the role of institutions in removing structural conditions of disadvantage and promoting gender equality, both in Italy and from a comparative perspective

item.description:
